body.name: profile-recentered observed-moment inversion
body.construction:
For \(\vartheta\in\overline\Theta_N(s_N)\), let \(g(\vartheta)\) stack, for each cohort \(c\), \(p_c\), \(p_c\Gamma_{S_c}m_c\), and \(p_c\operatorname{vech}[\Gamma_{S_c}(H_c+m_cm_c^{\prime})\Gamma_{S_c}^{\prime}+\sigma_c^2I]\). Compute \(d_N=\min_{\vartheta\in\overline\Theta_N(s_N)}\|g(\vartheta)-\widehat\theta\|_{\mathsf m}\) and retain
\[
\mathcal C_N=\left\{\vartheta\in\overline\Theta_N(s_N):
\|g(\vartheta)-\widehat\theta\|_{\mathsf m}
\le d_N+\widehat\rho_N\right\}.
\]
For \(N\ge2k_\alpha\), return the intersection of \([-b_\lambda,b_\lambda]^{CT}\) with the coordinatewise smallest rectangle enclosing
\[
\left\{(\Gamma m_c)_{c=1}^C:\vartheta\in\mathcal C_N\right\}.
\]
Compactness makes \(\mathcal C_N\) nonempty. On \(\mathsf F_N=\{N<2k_\alpha\}\), return \([-b_\lambda,b_\lambda]^{CT}\).
